body: Original badge-free 2994 salvage driving game sprite sheet, transparent landscape 7:4 PNG. EXACT regular 4 column 2 row grid, eight separated complete cars with generous 65px transparent gutters and 30px outer margins. Inspired by US 1988 Ford Thunderbird Turbo Coupe two-door notchback: long low rounded aerodynamic 1987-88 body, flush wide rectangular composite headlamps, thin black slit grille, twin small rectangular intercooler hood scoops, inset fog lamps in front bumper, long doors, wraparound rear quarter glass, short notchback trunk with modest integral lip, horizontal red rear lamp band. Weathered dark metallic blue body, muted cream replacement front fenders, thin red bumper trim, subtle salvage repair seams and scratches. NO logos badges words numbers plates. All road wheels and tires ABSENT with fully transparent wheel arch openings for animated wheels, no ground or shadows. Eight distinct exact orientations top: FRONT straight; FRONT LEFT quarter nose RIGHT; LEFT SIDE nose RIGHT; REAR LEFT quarter nose RIGHT. Bottom: REAR straight; REAR RIGHT quarter nose LEFT; RIGHT SIDE nose LEFT; FRONT RIGHT quarter nose LEFT. Keep each full car inside its own equal cell. Detailed original painterly photoreal game art, consistent color and perspective.
dashboard: Original badge-free 2994 cockpit overlay inspired by US 1988 Thunderbird Turbo Coupe, LEFT HAND DRIVE. Transparent ultrawide 3:1 PNG, straight ahead driver view. Broad low angular late-1980s dashboard, burgundy padded upper dash and lower panels, black rectangular instrument binnacle LEFT with a wide EMPTY DARK instrument region for live speed/rpm/gear gauges. Boxy rectangular center air vents above small rectangular cassette radio and simple climate sliders, broad rectangular glovebox on RIGHT. Distinct long horizontal restrained American coupe dash, NOT round sports car pods. Weathered dark-blue painted narrow pillars, restrained stitched repairs, original detailed painterly game art. No steering wheel: leave LEFT mounting position for shared animated wheel. No needles digits lettering logos badges. Windshield and outside upper area fully transparent, no scenery seats road or hands; dash lower half.
